answer: We establish Sybil resistance via dynamic opportunity-cost bonds governed by zero-knowledge delay proofs and a subgame-perfect slashing matrix. Splitting stake across pseudonymous entities locks capital in an illiquid tundra of unearned interest, while correlated deviations burn collateral down to a smoldering ember. As the transient comet of adversarial identities dissipates under strictly negative expected utility, multi-agent strategies converge to a unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
